result.reason: The revision appropriately reduces the notice period to 30 days and expressly addresses non-renewal without disturbing unrelated termination rights. However, it does not reach either playbook position because it includes no cap on renewal price increases. It also omits the 60-day Vendor reminder required by the preferred position. The drafting is generally workable, though the phrase “elect not to renew any renewal term…following the Initial Term” could more clearly tie notice to the applicable renewal date.
